packages/render/src/internal.ts.facts: Stopped-terminal wrappers retain native terminal tuples; public renderErrorContext resolves their device UIDs to designations and functions without changing the selected diagnostic.

packages/render/src/packet/conductor-con.facts: Continuation identities resolve through IR wires, jumpers and cable cores to endpoint terminal keys and native device designations; packet-global failures retain authored view scope.

packages/render/src/packet/device-legend.facts: Native legend-entry UIDs/designations survive tail, original-failure and sheet-limit fallback paths. legendCandidateLimited delegates unchanged page-cost construction, with public authored view scope for packet-global budget failures.

packages/render/src/packet/legend-bound-.facts: Measured tail or original fallback retains native legendEntries deviceUid/designation; the message names each owner and viewTitle. Page-cost-only fallback retains authored view identities at the public packet boundary.

packages/render/src/packet/legend-pagina.facts: Measured tail failures retain native legend entries; observed search caps change the explanation only. Page-cost failure construction retains caller view scope.

packages/render/src/packet/rooted-bank-g.facts: Leads with a measured boundary-cut retry failure and retains the original boundary identity.

packages/render/src/packet/rooted-constr.facts: Adds measured span constraints to the existing error without removing native identity details; public view context remains attached for packet-level bounds.

packages/render/src/packet/topology.ts.facts: Drawing fit refusals retain native referenced device names. Cached fallback projection/selection errors recover native UID-selected devices/functions from IR through topologySelectionContext.

packages/render/src/render-diagnostic-co.facts: Native designation/function/view details take precedence. Descriptor-only single-view context derives authored UID selections through IR; absent view identity is omitted. Only valid project names are included; guarded lookup failures mark scopeUnavailable without replacing the error.

packages/render/src/render-error-context.facts: IR lookup supplies native device/cable designations, functions, stopped terminals and trace-target names while preserving stable IDs.

packages/render/src/render-text-context..facts: Native text owner and conductor endpoints resolve to IR designations; invalid XML characters remain visibly escaped. Unlocatable project/title failures carry public caller view scope.

packages/render/src/rooted-diagnostics.t.facts: Preserves contextual rooted failures and adds the actual unsupported device designation/profile from IR; transformer endpoint failures retain their native boundary identities.

packages/render/src/selection/conservati.facts: Unrepresented-terminal R003 retains native device designation/terminal key, conductor identities and an authored circuit alternative; downstream context preserves these facts.

packages/render/src/view-normalization.t.facts: Root and trace-target UIDs resolve through IR to native designations; rejected targets retain targetDeviceUid and targetDesignation. Malformed selectors retain authored request identity.
